decisions.reason: As the flagship of a new product line in a market moving toward digital practices, the anamnesis app holds high growth-option value, and two years of dedicated presentation signal continued commitment.
The education institute is a low-cost complement that strengthens customer loyalty and training around the core software, so keeping this option open costs little.
Remote screen-sharing support is cheap to maintain and essential to support quality, especially after pandemic-era remote work, so there is no reason to abandon it.
The analytics dashboard fits the strategic direction toward efficiently managed practices, its prospects are still unfolding, and it builds on existing data at low marginal cost.
The complete practice bundle is mainly a packaging of existing modules, so keeping it costs little, though it may later be repackaged or renamed.
The job and practice listing portal lies further from the core business and faces strong external platforms, but its low upkeep cost justifies keeping the option while its value remains uncertain.
